entries.zh: 仁义钱：以仁义（情分）赊借、放账的钱款；凭情面出借的钱
entries.en: money lent as a favor, on goodwill; to lend on trust (benevolence-and-righteousness money)
entries.notes: L 栏 assos/endimen 为未展开缩写[疑]，錢字声调记 T99（污損）；释义据 H'仁義錢'+fiar（赊借）推定。

entries.zh: 代认：代人承认（债务）、代为担承；作保
entries.en: to acknowledge or undertake (a debt) on another's behalf; vouch for another
entries.notes: L 栏 assos 缩写未展开[疑]；M 栏 tāy xin 叠书两遍照录。

entries.zh: 担认：担承、认下（替人承担债务或责任）
entries.en: to undertake, take upon oneself (a debt or responsibility); stand for
entries.notes: L 栏 assos 缩写未展开[疑]。

entries.zh: 当人不当物：凭人的信用放账，不凭物件作抵押
entries.en: to lend on the man (his credit), not on the pawn; trust the person, not the goods
entries.notes: M 栏'不'字声调记 T99（污損），惟 L 自释与 H/M 互证清晰，不影响释义。

entries.zh: 图智不图力：凭智谋，不凭气力
entries.en: to trust in prudence/wisdom, not in force

entries.zh: 赊难讨：赊出的账难以讨还
entries.en: to sell on credit and collect with difficulty; credit given is hard to call in

entries.zh: 保领：作保、具保领回（以保状将人或物承领出来）
entries.en: to vouch for or give bail/security; stand surety and take charge

entries.notes: L 栏残缺（'de esso.'残段[残]）且 M 栏 gue/gie 形存疑[疑]；释义据 fiador 与'保家（保人）'通义。

entries.zh: 管领：具保领人、负责管束之人（保人）
entries.en: guarantor who takes charge (of a person); one who vouches and supervises
entries.notes: M 栏多出 haour 一词[疑]且其声调记 T99，未解；释义据其余三栏。

entries.zh: 领认人：作保承领之人、保人
entries.en: guarantor; person who vouches and takes on (another's obligation)

entries.zh: 认钱人：认下（他人）钱债之人、保人
entries.en: guarantor; person who answers for (another's) money or debt

entries.zh: 粉：粉条（米粉或薯粉所制条状食物）；下肉的粉（肉粉）
entries.en: fideos: starch/rice noodles; noodles served with meat
entries.notes: M 栏夹西语 de carne 且拼写 carne/carno 存疑[疑]；H 栏仅'粉'而 M 栏 hùn by 疑含'麵'。

entries.en: rice noodles in broth; noodle soup

entries.notes: H 栏首字在賁/賣之间存疑[疑]；释义据 fideos de harina 与 M 栏第二音节'…my（麵）'。

entries.zh: 面线：极细的面条、细挂面
entries.en: thin flour vermicelli; very thin wheat noodles
entries.notes: M 栏后半残损（[残]）并杂难辨西语字样（umenbo loa pulos[疑]）、声调记 T99；释义据 L+H'麵線'。

entries.zh: 海粉：海中所产的细条状食物（海味干货）
entries.en: 'sea fideos' — strand-shaped food from the sea; marine delicacy

entries.zh: 操节：守节、保持节操（尤指孀妇守贞；忠实、尽责、正直、诚实）
entries.en: to keep faith and integrity (of a man to a woman; of a widow: faithful, dutiful, just, upright, truthful)
entries.notes: L 栏缩写链 viuded./cumplix./recta./veracador 依赖推断展开[疑]；孀妇守节之义与 L 栏自释相合。
